# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c10 P86](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0086), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolchild  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with gentle, mild hazel eyes and a straight nose. She has long, sleek yellow curls that never get out of order and a prim mouth. She looks neat and proper, often sitting as primly as if she had just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily well-behaved, timid, obedient, and quiet. She is an industrious, reliable little soul who enjoys helping with small household tasks such as shelling peas, wiping dishes, and feeding chickens. Unlike her mischievous twin brother, she never causes trouble and follows instructions faithfully, though her extreme predictability leads some to view her as a bit monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033)_

## History

Following her sick mother's death, Dora and her twin brother Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert to live at Green Gables. During her first week there, Davy coaxed her onto a pigpen fence, causing her to fall in, and subsequently drenched her with pump water under the pretense of washing her dress. Shortly after, Davy tricked her and locked her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse, leaving her frightened and cold until Anne Shirley found her. When autumn arrived, she began attending school with Anne as her teacher, sitting with Mirabel Cotton and getting frightened by Mirabel's tales of a deceased walking uncle. She survived a terrifying hailstorm at Green Gables by calmly holding Anne's hand and praying. After her uncle Richard Keith passed away, leaving a monetary inheritance for her maintenance, Marilla and Anne decided to keep her permanently.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c24 P30](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Her father died when she was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Her mother, Mary Keith, was sick for a long time before passing away  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007)</sub>
- Her uncle Richard Keith died of consumption, leaving two thousand dollars in trust for her and Davy  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
